fullContentHtml:
IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 – Extend - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) has released the Notification for the Common Admission Test (CAT-2026) For Post Graduate Programmes in Management IIM CAT 2026 Admission Test on the official website of the IIM CAT recently. Applications for the IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 has Started on 03 August 2026, & candidate can apply until 22 September 2026. The online examination will held on 29 November 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 given below.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

What is IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 – Extend?

IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 – Extend is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The official website is: https://www.All India Exam Result/iim-cat-admission-2026/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
